party.party_prefix_rule: slot0 unconditional; first slot 1..5 with signed id <= 0 ends prefix; otherwise 6
party.preset_rule: append every non--1 preset before scanning the party prefix only to mark matching mandatory states

round_loop.confirm_effect: sample current key states before each slot hidden check; clear all three and disable automatic mode before actor rendering
round_loop.released_confirmation: a key released before the slot boundary does not cancel automatic mode
round_loop.hidden_actor: skip dispatch, then evaluate outcome and clear hidden AI targets
round_loop.action_result_six: decrement actor index before common post-action calls

speed_sort.algorithm: pairwise exchange sort, fixed first slot against every later slot, descending signed effective speed
speed_sort.equal_speed_order: no direct swap on equality; indirect exchanges may reverse equal-speed actors

round_order.sort: signed descending; equal values do not swap
round_order.round_value: max(0, effective_speed/15 - role.hurt/40), signed truncation toward zero

battle_setup.party_prefix_rule: slot0 unconditional; first slot 1..5 with signed id <= 0 ends prefix; otherwise 6
